draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Glad to hear things are going well, and that the dashboard/export question Tariq picked up is now closed out — thanks for flagging it.

Since the layout is still settling in, one thing that usually helps is getting a second person in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so it's easy to split work once someone else is in.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through your first teammate and next steps with you.

Best,
Chidi
